scope: Isolated Hunspell package review and offline native build; no tracked checkout, runtime, remote, or network mutation

concrete_defect.finding: Normal dispose killed the worker without closing its native dictionary handle. Repeated provider cycles retained one additional handle per cycle. Immediate forced termination could also interrupt ownership registration after native open returned.
repair: Send a serialized close command and await acknowledgement before terminating the worker.
Settle pending callers immediately; limit waiting for acknowledgement to one second.
Attach NativeFinalizer ownership to every successful native handle and detach it on explicit close.
Use Isolate.beforeNextEvent for fallback termination so current native open/check completes its ownership handoff.

forced_exit_exercises: Already-owned handle in a delayed native spelling call
Native handle allocated inside delayed open before returning to Dart
Provider timeout with the native worker active
counter_evidence.scope_note: Counters and delays are confined to review/test libraries. Real adapter spelling, suggestion logic, and bundled Hunspell sources are otherwise unchanged.

native_build.method: Direct GCC equivalent of native CMake target, from committed bundled source archive
